svg.title: Crescent competing-risks longitudinal EHR Transformer architecture
svg.desc: Animated schematic showing static covariates and pre-index clinical events entering the Crescent encoder with a 3-layer Transformer, condition-specific cross-attention and additive log-hazards, a parallel death head, and 10-year competing-risks cumulative incidence trajectories.
